# doctrine-firebird-driver

Doctrine DBAL driver for Firebird SQL 3.0+. Wraps the satwareAG/php-firebird
native PHP extension (fbird_* procedural API) with full Doctrine DBAL
integration, including schema management, transactions, and ORM support.

## Docs
- README: /README.md
- Changelog: /CHANGELOG.md
- Testing guide: /docs/TESTING.md
- Contributing: /docs/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Repos
- Source: https://github.com/satwareAG/doctrine-firebird-driver
- Issues: https://github.com/satwareAG/doctrine-firebird-driver/issues

## Dependencies
- Upstream: https://github.com/satwareAG/php-firebird (native extension, ext-firebird ^11.1)
- Stubs: https://github.com/satwareAG/php-firebird-stubs (satwareag/php-firebird-stubs ^11.1)
- Doctrine DBAL: https://github.com/doctrine/dbal (^3.10 on 3.10.x branch, ^4.4 on 4.4.x branch)

## SDD
- Methodology: https://github.com/satwareAG/spec-kit
- Metadata: /specs/metadata.json
- IPADP conformance: L3

## Branches
- 3.10.x: DBAL ^3.10 (active, current release: v3.13.0-RC.1)
- 4.4.x: DBAL ^4.4 (active)

## Test
- PHP 8.2-8.5 x Firebird 3.0/4.0/5.0 matrix
- Docker-based: cd tests && ./phpunit.sh
- Quality: PHPStan 8, Psalm, PHPCS (Doctrine standard)
